article_title: Palworld Leaves Early Access on July 10 With a 1.0 Launch Across PC and Consoles, the World Tree Endgame, and Its Biggest Batch of New Pals Yet

content_preview.title: Palworld Leaves Early Access on July 10 With a 1.0 Launch Across PC and Consoles, the World Tree Endgame, and Its Biggest Batch of New Pals Yet
content_preview.summary: Pocketpair will ship Palworld's version 1.0 on July 10, 2026 across PC, PS5, Xbox, and Game Pass, ending more than two years of early access with a 27-page changelog, flight, the World Tree endgame, and its largest batch of new Pals.
content_preview.body_excerpt:
## Overview

Pocketpair will end Palworld's early access run on July 10, 2026, when its full release hits PC, PS5, Xbox Series X|S, and Game Pass at the same time, [GamesRadar+](https://www.gamesradar.com/games/survival/palworld-1-0-is-bigger-in-scale-than-any-update-the-games-gotten-but-pocketpair-still-isnt-adding-pokemon-style-pal-evolutions/) reports. The version 1.0 date was announced during the Summer Game Fest stream, marking the moment the creature-collecting survival game finally gradua...

editor_notes.content_quality: Clean, well-structured News piece (555 words, within the 400-1200 range). Overview/What We Know/Context/What We Don't Know structure is appropriate, every specific is attributed inline, and the article carefully labels teased-but-unconfirmed content. No editorializing.
editor_notes.source_verification: All 5 source snapshots read from disk (all status 200, none archive fallbacks). source-0.html.gz (GamesRadar 'coming next month') CONFIRMS July 10 2026, Summer Game Fest announcement, 'little over two years' since early access, and the 'uncharted territories'/'fragments of a grand narrative that inches closer to the truth of the world' press-release quotes. source-1.html.gz (GamesRadar 'bigger in scale/no evolutions') CONFIRMS the platform lineup verbatim ('PC, PS5, Xbox Series X|S, and Game Pass at the same time' on July 10 2026), the Discord quote '1.0 is bigger in scale than any update we have ever released,' 'many many many new Pals' + new region + fleshed-out narrative, the 'We aren't doing evolutions' quote, and the lawsuit 'zero chance'/'chump change' legal-expert framing. source-2.html.gz (GamesRadar 'sounds huge') CONFIRMS 'More than we've ever added before in any one update,' the jester-esque Pal named Dupin, and 'nearly 200 Pals' already in the game. source-3.html.gz (PC Gamer '27 pdf pages') CONFIRMS the '27 pdf pages of changes and additions' quote, the flight-enabling wing pack + grab bag of new items and pals, 'over 35,000 concurrent players... according to SteamDB,' the official card game, and the World Tree as a teased narrative component. source-4.html.gz (PC Gamer 'won't wipe your data') CONFIRMS the World Tree looming over the northwest corner of the map tied to the ending scenario, the Steam-page trailer quote 'new Pals, new areas, an ominous new threat, and the long-awaited World Tree,' Buckley's title (head of publishing and communications), and the full 'You do NOT need to wipe your data for Palworld 1.0' / 'But you should' / 'Players can continue their existing saves...' Discord quotes. Every direct quote appears verbatim in its cited snapshot.
editor_notes.factual_accuracy: No hallucinations detected. July 10 2026 launch date, four-platform lineup (PC/PS5/Xbox Series X|S/Game Pass), World Tree endgame details, the 27-page changelog, the Dupin Pal, the ~200 existing Pals, the SteamDB concurrency, and every Buckley quote all trace to the cited snapshots. Specifically verified that PvP, Sky Islands, and Genetic Recombination -- which the Journalist flagged as appearing only in non-allowlisted search summaries -- do NOT appear in any of the 5 snapshots and do NOT appear anywhere in the article body; they were correctly excluded.
editor_notes.tone_assessment: Neutral and professional. Colloquial source phrasings ('chump change,' 'jester-like Pal') are presented as quotations/attributions rather than the article's own voice. No sensationalism, no AI self-reference.
editor_notes.originality: Genuinely new topic. No prior Palworld or Pocketpair coverage exists in the archive. The only nearby item is a Halo remake release story (July 1), an unrelated title.
editor_notes.overall_assessment: APPROVE. A well-sourced, neutrally written launch-news piece. All quotes and specifics verified verbatim against the committed snapshots; the speculative/unconfirmed off-allowlist details (PvP, Sky Islands, Genetic Recombination) were correctly kept out of the body.
